templates.name: Broadsheet
templates.tagline: A talking head cut like a newspaper coming alive
best_for: anyone with a point to make fast
does: punch-ins every ~1.6 s across three framings
a newsprint page every 6-8 s (kicker, headline, deck, engraving)
pages slapped in and whipped out
clipping captions (white serif on tilted black paper strips)
byline name tag
number cards, logo tiles, object pop-ups, one type slam
intros and fillers cut
warm newsprint grade, groovy bed
templates.note: First attempt rejected by Ahmed (29 Sep): rebuild from his reference examples.

templates.name: Folio
templates.tagline: Calm, premium talking head with editorial collage pages
does: hook page at 2-4 s on the spoken words
collage pages with an engraving on every page
name tag from the first frame
number cards on enumerations
logo tiles when a tool is named
object pop-ups with a word label
one type slam
serif captions in a phrase-sized box
face-centred framing and colour matching
lo-fi bed with drops
paper, pen and zoom sound layer
opening burn in the brand colour

templates.name: Noir
templates.tagline: Black-and-white cinema documentary: letterbox bars, serif subtitles with one gold word, slow push-ins, chapter cards
templates.note: Look ported from Ahmed's Noir (premium-noir, public BETA on his side). Needs no B-roll. The piano bed (silent-descent) is not shipped in this fork, so the reel builds without music (music.optional); chapter cards are optional endcard beats (variant caps, font serif). His noir_score.py sound pass is not part of the style. Colour variants premium-noir-ice / -jade / -red / -rose / -silver are styles only, as with the other colour themes.
